policy: Latest eligible exact-end annual 20-F XBRL observations with 350–370-day durations. Null is not zero. Fiscal years are calendar years. Data must be checked against annual statements for unusual signs/reclassifications. Narrow capital excludes several operating assets and liabilities, taxes and acquired assets; not comprehensive ROIC. No R&D capitalization. Reported depreciation excludes separately reported acquired amortization but CAMT Note8 includes lease ROU assets; operating-lease-cost/depreciation reconciliation remains unresolved. Historical reported depreciation is not assumed to be clean physical depreciation. CAMT diluted weighted shares2019 onward have source-labeled1000x XBRL scale correction, checked against primary statements. PPE includes ROU assets in annual filings and is not directly comparable to interim separate ROU presentation. FY2016–17 CFO is continuing but cash capex may contain disposed-business scope; CFO less capex is a reported diagnostic, not normalized FCFF.
